metadata.name: MATNeuron
metadata.author: Kobayashi, R.; Tsubo, Y.; Shinomoto, S.
metadata.description: Non-resetting MAT* neuron with two exact adaptive-threshold memories

dynamics.theta1: theta1 * exp(-dt / tau_1) + (alpha_1 if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta1 * exp(-dt / tau_1) + theta2 * exp(-dt / tau_2) else 0.0)
dynamics.theta2: theta2 * exp(-dt / tau_2) + (alpha_2 if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta1 * exp(-dt / tau_1) + theta2 * exp(-dt / tau_2) else 0.0)
dynamics.refractory_remaining: refractory_period if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta1 * exp(-dt / tau_1) + theta2 * exp(-dt / tau_2) else max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt)
dynamics.spike_flag: 1.0 if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta1 * exp(-dt / tau_1) + theta2 * exp(-dt / tau_2) else 0.0

extensions.source_equations: Kobayashi, Tsubo, and Shinomoto 2009 Eqs. 1-3, DOI 10.3389/neuro.10.009.2009
extensions.discretisation: Forward Euler voltage at 0.001 ms; exact exponential threshold histories; sampled level detection
extensions.profile_note: Defaults are the paper's regular-spiking example, not universal biological constants.
extensions.refractory_note: Voltage continues evolving during the 2 ms absolute refractory interval and may re-emit if still suprathreshold when it expires.
extensions.identity_note: The historical SC reset/RK4 recurrence is separately named SCResettingMATNeuron.
